turns.message: Radiology per-patient ROI is unproven and GPU cost is high. Chatbots and front-door scheduling show limited incremental value, and chronic care reimbursement models remain unclear. We should prioritize finance automation, where 83% of hospitals have ERP integrated, finance AI is live, and systems are audit-friendly.

verdict.summary: Enterprise back-office and claims automation provide the most dependable efficiency gains given strong ERP penetration and documented discharge turnaround cuts. High GPU expenses, thin EMR adoption, and unproven clinical ROI restrict immediate expansion into specialized diagnostic and longitudinal tracking tools.
